description: Unit tests for SSL cipher suite name functions in the net::ssl namespace, including parsing, string conversion, and protocol status checks.

methods.name: MakeConnectionStatus
methods.description: Creates a connection status integer based on version and cipher suite.

methods.name: SSLCipherSuiteToStrings
methods.description: Converts cipher suite code to human-readable strings for key exchange, cipher, and MAC.

methods.name: ParseSSLCipherString
methods.description: Parses a string representation of a cipher suite into its numeric code.

methods.name: ObsoleteSSLStatus
methods.description: Determines if a connection status involves obsolete SSL protocols, key exchange, cipher, or signature.

methods.name: IsTLSCipherSuiteAllowedByHTTP2
methods.description: Checks if a cipher suite is permitted for HTTP/2.
